nina: Draft RN for small hotfix (runtime v2.3.6 -> v2.3.7) targeting tonight 01:30 PT. Change window 01:30 PT -> 02:00 PT. Fixes: 1) batching stall under >1k RPS, 2) Dedicated autoscale cooldown tweak, 3) minor logging noise reduction. Need sign-off on RN and rollback plan (quick rollback to v2.3.6).

sam-ops: I'll be on deploy. Canary plan: 5% for 8m -> 30% for 10m -> 100%. Rollback triggers: error rate >=2.5% for 5m OR p95 > 750ms for 8m.

cara: Quick RN suggestion: include a link to the changelog and callout "no schema changes". Also add a line under Known Impacts: "Transient reconnects for Dedicated customers during autoscale events."

jon: Infra: pin fallback to v2.3.6 for 30m. I'll prepare the routing command. Also add the troubleshooting doc link.

sam-ops: Deploy queued when staging smoke is green. Command:
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.3.7 canary=5% step=8m health=svc-metrics-check
```
To rollback: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.3.6 --reason "canary fail"`.

deploybot: deploy job created by sam-ops. Staging smoke pending. Will post back on progress.

nina: I will send an internal brief at 01:10 PT and post the RN in the #releases channel.

sam-ops: Sounds good. If anything odd I'll abort and run rollback + pin. Everyone ok with rollback thresholds?

cara: Yep. RN updated with changelog link.

jon: Ready on infra.

sam-ops: Confirmed, starting deploy at 01:30 PT unless hold.
